en: A color postcard featuring a mountain refuge in front of dramatic rocky peaks under a clear blue sky. The central image shows the Rifugio Ciampedie hut with white walls, blue-trimmed windows and people relaxing outside, set against the steep spires of the Dolomites. The surrounding border is white, with vertical text along the left margin and a large caption "DOLOMITI" at the bottom.
